page.overview:
Who is K.K. Slider?

K.K. Slider is an Animal Crossing minifigure introduced in 2024.

K.K. Slider is a dog who works as a traveling musician, playing songs on his guitar. He is a worldwide celebrity, having many fans, and has many albums of a wide range of music genres. He often performs live concerts during his travels. He has an obvious passion for performing for others, and offers to play for people on a weekly basis. He has appeared in every game since the first game's release in Japan in 2001.
